stories.title: Nifty ends at record high as banks rally
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 closed at a record high on Friday as banks and IT stocks rallied after the central bank held the repo rate and signalled that inflation was easing faster than expected, while foreign investors returned to Indian equities for a third straight session.
